# OftCmdHelper
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/libraries/OftCmdHelper.sol)

**Title:**
OftCmdHelper

Helper library for creating OFT commands for taxi/bus modes

Used by Stargate V2 for transport mode selection


## Functions
### taxi

Creates taxi mode command (immediate execution)


```solidity
function taxi() internal pure returns (bytes memory);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`|Empty bytes for taxi mode|


### bus

Creates bus mode command (batched execution)


```solidity
function bus() internal pure returns (bytes memory);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`|Single byte array for bus mode|


### drive

Creates drive mode command with passengers


```solidity
function drive(bytes memory _passengers) internal pure returns (bytes memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_passengers`|`bytes`|The passenger data to include|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`|The passengers data for drive mode|
